radiation_column.dependency_check: Cl_EpsA never reads i or j. Its input arrays Wrad, CGp, Rp, Dz1, Dz2 and Program.ZZ depend only on k. Its temperature input is explicitly Program.TABS[1][1][kk-1]. Wcrit, EpsTop and TTop are constants.
radiation_column.side_effect_check: Cl_EpsA writes only its four ref outputs and returns Tabi. Cl_Eps calculates from its other inputs and overwrites Epsi before returning; the old ref values cannot affect the answer. New locals initialized to zero are safe.
radiation_column.lifetime_check: Every RADIATRAD invocation recomputes the values, so no cache invalidation state is introduced. The existing k loop still writes exactly levels 2 through NK, including original halo columns 1 through NI/NJ.
radiation_column.parallel_check: The changed loop is serial and runs after the solar Parallel.For has completed. It adds no parallel state or ordering change.
radiation_column.minimality: The patch retains existing arrays and method signature. Removing unused method parameters or changing the arrays to one-dimensional storage would widen scope without being required for this benefit.
radiation_column.component_scope: Actual source loop and actual Cl_EpsA/Cl_Eps bodies extracted without arithmetic edits. Five cloud profiles include both sides of Wcrit; tests include nonuniform previous output cells, NaN prior ref values, and NZ=25 with NK=3 followed by NK=25.

uvw_sources.consumer_check: UIMPKernel initializes m=2 before kn=1. Its lower-half branch reads only F1U/F1V/F1W and sets m=1; its upper-half branch reads only F2U/F2V/F2W and resets m=2. Therefore F1 is consumed only for odd kn and F2 only for even kn across all eight kernel calls.
uvw_sources.external_consumer_check: All references were searched across src. The separate UIMP/VIMP/WIMP implementations initialize their own corresponding source arrays before consuming them. No other routine reads skipped entries.
uvw_sources.bounds_and_flags: The source-loop bounds and k mapping are unchanged. The whole method remains under ICU. ICPSI branches, buoyancy, Coriolis terms and every arithmetic expression for consumed entries are unchanged.
uvw_sources.parallel_check: Source workers write distinct i columns, and the prepass completes before solver sweeps begin. The patch adds only a local parity boolean and conditional writes.
uvw_sources.minimality: Keeps source-array layout, producer ordering and all solver sweeps. Further combining source calculations would change more expressions and is unnecessary.
uvw_sources.component_scope: Actual UVWIMPcalculate with five grids (NZ 2,3,8,28,65), terrain terms off/on, ICPSI off/on, ICU off/on, worker settings 1/4/8, two unused-slot sentinels and three sequential coefficient stages. A single sweep partition fixes recurrence order while retaining native parallel source prepasses.
